profile.text:
Phantom, an assassin who has acted independently in Victoria and surrounding areas, has been difficult to identify in the past, and his previous history has not yet been fully verified. 
He has now joined Rhodes Island as a specialist and boasts exceptional combat capabilities, but must be treated with caution.
